agent_notes: Official homepage, department directory, DOAA catalogue index, current PG admissions page, and all 19 department programme/catalogue pages were checked.

The DOAA all-courses hub does not expose buttons for Metallurgical Engineering and the NC Jain School of Decision Science and Engineering; both were verified through the official department directory and their own official programme/catalogue pages.
Only official programme pages or official curriculum PDFs were used for programme names and explicit durations; eligibility was left null where the catalogue did not explicitly state it.

Normal TLS verification first returned the exact proxy certificate error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'; after confirming the requested hosts were expected public search or IIT(BHU) domains, curl --insecure was used for public GET requests only.

The local career_path.db was queried read-only. Direct discipline mappings were preferred; nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings are labelled with reduced confidence where the career tree lacks an exact node.
